description: Fetch the full text of an arXiv paper. Tries arxiv.org/html first, falls back to ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org, and falls back again to text extracted from the PDF when neither has an HTML render — check the source field to know which one answered. Page through long papers with start and max_characters, or pass max_characters null to get the entire body in one call. To read one section, take the outline from the first page (start 0) and pass an entry's start.

max_characters.description: Maximum characters of paper body to return, counted after boilerplate stripping. Defaults to 100,000; pass null to return the entire body in one call. Whole-paper reads can exceed a client tool-result size cap — math-heavy bodies run 300KB-1MB+ — so prefer the default plus start-based paging unless the full text is needed. When truncated, a notice and the total character count are included.

paper_id.description: arXiv paper ID: "2401.12345", "2401.12345v2" (a pinned version), or a pre-2007 ID like "hep-th/9901001" (archive spelled as arXiv issued it), optionally prefixed "arXiv:", or an arxiv.org abs, pdf, or html URL, with or without https:// or a ?query or #fragment.

start.description: Character offset into the cleaned body to begin reading from. Defaults to 0. Use with max_characters to page through long papers — e.g., start=100000 with max_characters=100000 returns chars 100,000–199,999 — or pass an outline entry's start to read from that heading. The total length is reported as body_characters in the response.

name: arxiv_read_paper

abstract_url.description: arXiv abstract page URL for attribution.

body_characters.description: Character count of the full cleaned body. Use with start and max_characters to page. Typically 3-4× smaller than total_characters for math-heavy HTML papers.

content.description: Paper body for the requested slice — the article as cleaned HTML, with relative image, object, and link URLs made absolute (in-page #fragment links stay as written), when source is arxiv_html or ar5iv; plain text when source is pdf_text. Empty when start is past body_characters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_id`: paper_id is not an arXiv identifier in an accepted form. `no_match`: Paper ID is not present in the arXiv index. `content_unavailable`: Paper exists but neither arxiv.org/html nor ar5iv has an HTML rendering and arXiv served no PDF either. `pdf_extraction_failed`: Paper has no HTML rendering and its PDF carries no text layer — an image-only or scanned submission. `version_unavailable`: A version-pinned paper_id was requested, arXiv is unreachable, and the local mirror holds only a different version — per-version reads require the live API. `version_not_served`: paper_id pins a superseded version of a pre-2007 paper that arXiv's API answers HTTP 500 for. The version exists, but its metadata cannot be returned. `rate_limited`: arXiv has throttled requests (HTTP 429 or "Rate exceeded." body). `invalid_request`: arXiv rejected the metadata lookup (HTTP 4xx other than 429). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

outline.description: Section headings of the whole cleaned body in document order, each with the start that reads from it. Returned only when start is 0. Empty for pdf_text, whose text carries no reliable headings. At most 200 entries — see outline_omitted_levels and outline_continues_at.

items.description: A part, chapter, section, subsection, subsubsection, paragraph, appendix, or bibliography heading.

level.description: Heading depth from its tag number minus one: h2 = 1, h3 = 2, and so on to h6 = 5.

start.description: Offset of the heading in the cleaned body. Pass as start to read from it.

title.description: Heading text with markup removed, e.g. "3.1 Encoder and Decoder Stacks"; cut at 120 characters.

outline_continues_at.description: Present when the shallowest heading level alone has more than 200 headings, so outline stops at its first 200: the start of the first heading left out. Pass it as start to read on from there.

outline_omitted_levels.description: Heading levels left out of outline because the paper has more than 200 headings, deepest first. Present only when levels were left out.

revision_unconfirmed.description: Present, true, when source is ar5iv: ar5iv keeps one render per paper whatever version is asked for, so the body may be another revision than paper_id, while pdf_url is exactly the paper_id revision. Absent for every other source, and for an unversioned read where the arXiv API reported v1 as the only version of the paper.

source.description: Which upstream artifact the body was read from. arxiv_html and ar5iv are HTML renders; pdf_text is text extracted from the PDF, where prose is reliable but math, tables, and heading structure are flattened. ar5iv keeps one render per paper, so an ar5iv body can be another revision than paper_id (see revision_unconfirmed).

start.description: Character offset of the first character in content within the cleaned body.

title.description: Paper title (from metadata, not parsed from HTML).

total_characters.description: Character count of the body before cleaning — the article HTML, without the site header and footer, for arxiv_html and ar5iv; equal to body_characters for pdf_text, which needs no cleaning.

truncated.description: True when more body content exists past this slice (start + content.length < body_characters).

title: Arxiv Read Paper
